graph.source_fallback: All production helper paths inspected directly; tests read in bounded chunks, with literal method search.

findings.mechanism: Passing final checks only require an earlier Manager accept; supplied earlier failed Planner checks in the same attempt are ignored. A duplicate later check can change FAIL to PASS against unchanged candidate without rework.
findings.minimal_patch: Reject accept/passed final-check paths when a known unmet original Planner result remains for this task/plan/attempt; repairs retain failed history and use a new authorized attempt.
findings.acceptance_test: Our negative control rejected; existing failed-Planner fresh-Worker recovery positive control remains valid.

findings.mechanism: Known failures lookup considers only failed Tester reports. A prior real Reviewer MISMATCH/failed result for exact candidate can be omitted from report_ids and accepted after another passing Reviewer result.
findings.minimal_patch: Reject acceptance when earlier supplied failed mandatory Reviewer reports remain for exact task/attempt/candidate, preserving failure in new-attempt recovery.
findings.acceptance_test: Insert failed MISMATCH report before later passing Reviewer; accept must reject even when report_ids omits failed report.

findings.mechanism: accept coverage unions Tester and Reviewer acceptance IDs. Tester can verify AC1 only, Reviewer report AC2 only while rerunning AC1, and Manager accepts AC1+AC2. AC2 has no independent Tester verification.
findings.minimal_patch: Require separate passing Tester coverage and passing Reviewer coverage for all accepted original criteria; validate rerun acceptance_id against Reviewer assignment if relevant.
findings.acceptance_test: Split AC1/AC2 coverage rejected; full original sequence and valid bounded non-final assignments remain supported.

findings.mechanism: Sequence equates MATCH with passed report status. A Reviewer cannot truthfully fail original-plan comparison for a substantive discrepancy when independent deterministic rerun correctly matches. validate_message accepts the failed report but validate_sequence rejects it.
findings.minimal_patch: Require MATCH for passing report, but allow failed/blocked report with MATCH. Preserve discrepancy and failure; repeated command is repeatability only.
findings.acceptance_test: MATCH plus failed report and substantive discrepancy validates as an observed failed report; Manager acceptance still rejects it. MISMATCH plus passed continues rejection.

findings.mechanism: Final plan.check compares plan_ref only; a different Planner instance can issue it under the same original plan although workflow requires original Planner final comparison.
findings.minimal_patch: Bind plan.check sender/recipient to original plan.publish actors as supplied consistency, not authentication.
findings.acceptance_test: Changed final Planner rejected; same original Planner recovery accepted. External provenance remains host-observed.

findings.mechanism: Republished same plan_id/revision checks only plan_ref and acceptance_ids; published objective and scope can change silently with unchanged referenced plan.
findings.minimal_patch: Require complete immutable published payload and actors for same plan/revision (except envelope message ID/reply) or reject republication; do not silently overwrite original plan record.
findings.acceptance_test: Changed objective or scope republication rejected; exact republication behavior explicitly documented.

already_covered: Strict bounded UTF-8 decoding, duplicate JSON keys, NaN/Infinity/numeric overflow, unencodable surrogates, boolean plan revision/exit rejection, unknown fields, ordered criterion text/ID fidelity with no normalization, stale source digest, role-specific schema and hash/containment checks exist and are exercised by current tests.
authoritative_criteria_ref is trusted caller input; SHA256 does not authenticate Owner approval. No authentic separately approved Gate3 fixture established.
Context-free structure or manager-created actor labels cannot establish actual host identity; expected_senders must come from observed transport.
Prefix sequences intentionally support pre-dispatch validation; acceptance of a prefix or empty list is not task-completion evidence. No final completion claim made from prefix validation.
unverified_or_instruction_only: Simultaneous Worker assignments are not rejected by the helper. One-mutating-Worker is policy; no scheduler/OS enforcement is promised.
Unknown terminal report duplicates and blocked-report recovery need explicit causal semantics before treating as mandatory failure; no speculative scheduler added.
Artifact checks resolve then open and remain TOCTOU vulnerable; not OS isolation. Windows symlink privilege can skip tests; this does not pass isolation.
No live runtime authenticity can be established by syntactic executable/workdir strings or evidence references alone. Native command observations are required.
